k.integr.p.voice: Voice control requires Discord to be open and the application authorized. Voice RPC scopes are privileged: Discord only allows them for the owner or testers of the personal app.
k.integr.spotify.ph: Client ID of the Spotify app
k.lib.opt.scan_all: Re-download everything from scratch (uses a lot of quota)
k.lib.opt.scan_missing: Fill in missing data (retry the sources that didn't find it before)
k.lib.plan.tip: How many games and requests per source, and the time and days needed
k.lib.rebuild.p: Recalculates games, versions, and collections from the cache, without downloading anything.
k.lib.rom.hint: — consoles are recognized from the folder name. Scraping only queries games never searched before, so it's fast even on large libraries.
k.lib.sch.p: Runs while the app is open (even when minimized to the tray). Respects limits: if a quota runs out, it resumes the next day.
k.lib.setup.tip: ROM folder, PC stores, and source accounts, step by step
k.lib.watch.chk: Automatically add games I copy into the ROM folders
k.lib.watch.p: Checks the folders every few seconds, waits for the copy to finish, and works slowly during a game so it doesn't slow it down.
k.m.clip_denied: The browser doesn't allow clipboard access: paste into the field
k.m.confirm_stop: Close the game on the PC?
k.m.dl_many: {n} downloads added to the PC queue
k.m.dl_one: {n} download added to the PC queue
k.m.ds.hint: The screen is coming from the PC…
k.m.edit.hint: Drag a button to move it
k.m.edit_only: You can move the buttons for Xbox, PlayStation, Switch, and GameCube
k.m.gp.hint: Connect a controller to the phone (Bluetooth) and press a button
k.m.gun.hint: Tap where you want to aim: your finger holds the left mouse button
k.m.gyro_again: Tap the gyroscope button again to grant permission
k.m.gyro_https: The gyroscope requires an HTTPS connection
k.m.gyro_unavail: Gyroscope not available on the PC
k.m.help.arcade: Arcade: 6 buttons like an arcade stick (LP/MP/HP on top, LK/MK/HK below).
k.m.help.buzz: Buzz!: each phone is a player. On the PC: Settings › Phone and streaming › “Set up PCSX2 for Buzz!” (once, with PCSX2 closed).
k.m.help.gc: GameCube: the buttons send their letter (A = A, B = B…): in Dolphin the XInput controller maps without surprises.
k.m.help.guitar: Guitar: hold the colored buttons and move the pick; ⭐ = Star Power. On the PC: “Set up PCSX2 for guitar”.
k.m.help.gun: Gun / touchpad: moves the PC mouse (must be allowed on the PC in Settings › Phone and streaming). In DuckStation/PCSX2 choose GunCon with the mouse; in melonDS the stylus is the mouse.
k.m.help.mic: Microphone: requires a virtual audio cable on the PC (e.g. VB-Cable). In PCSX2 add the SingStar USB microphone and choose “CABLE Output”.
k.m.help.motion: Motion: in the emulator, choose DSU / cemuhook as the motion source, server 127.0.0.1, port 26760, slot {slot} (Cemu, Ryujinx, Dolphin, Azahar). Aim: for games without a gyroscope.
k.m.help.nunchuk: Nunchuk: stick, C and Z on the left; Wii Remote on the right. Tilt and shake with the gyroscope. On the PC: “Set up Dolphin for the Wii Remote”.
k.m.help.wheel: Steering wheel: tilt the phone like a wheel (left stick), pressure pedals: the higher you touch, the harder you press. “Center” if the steering pulls to one side. Sensitivity controls how much you turn.
k.m.help.wii: Wii Remote: buttons, tilt, shake, and pointer (gyroscope) reach Dolphin from the DSU server. On the PC: “Set up Dolphin for the Wii Remote”.
k.m.help.wiis: Sideways Wii Remote (like an NES): hold it horizontally, 1 and 2 on the right. On the PC: “Set up Dolphin for the Wii Remote”.
k.m.home_count: {n} games: open one or search in 🔍 Library.
k.m.https_warn: Open the PC's https address: without HTTPS the app won't install and the gyroscope won't work
k.m.hw.p: I'm using it as the PC controller: the on-screen buttons are hidden.
k.m.inst.help: If the app won't install or the “not private” warning still appears, the PC certificate is missing: on the PC, go to Settings › 📱 Phone and streaming › 🔒 PC certificate.
k.m.inst.s1: Tap Share (the square with the arrow) at the bottom of Safari.
k.m.inst.s3: Open the Pozzo Launcher icon: it starts full screen, without the browser bar.
k.m.inst.title: ⬇ Install Pozzo Launcher
k.m.install_tip: Install the app on your phone
k.m.keys.p: Keys pressed on the PC: for game menus and for controlling the PC remotely.
k.m.lib_empty: Library is empty: add games from the app on the PC.
k.m.lobby.p: Tap a seat to move there (if it's taken, you swap). Nobody has to reconnect.
k.m.mic.ok: 🎤 The PC is playing your voice through “{device}”. In PCSX2, choose the other end of the cable as the microphone.
k.m.mic.p: The phone's microphone becomes a PC microphone (SingStar in PCSX2).
k.m.mic_nohttps: This browser doesn't allow microphone access (HTTPS required)
k.m.moon.first: The first time: in Pozzo Launcher on the PC, press “📡 Publish to Moonlight” (Settings › Phone and streaming), otherwise “▶ Game in progress” won't appear. Don't have Moonlight? Install it.
k.m.moon.intro: The game is starting on the PC. To play it here:
k.m.moon.pick: Choose ▶ Game in progress: you're in the game. Controls: Moonlight's on-screen buttons or a Bluetooth controller connected to the phone.

k.m.no_link: No link found: an http(s):// or magnet:? address is required
k.m.no_running: No game running on the PC.
k.m.no_sensors: This phone has no motion sensors
k.m.pair.p: Enter the code you see on the PC in Settings › Phone (or scan the QR code).
k.m.paste_ph: Paste one or more links (one per line)
k.m.play_pad: 🎮 Play with the phone as a controller
k.m.players_tip: Player lobby: who's who, swap seats

k.m.ps.nlabel: Switch: send the letters (Nintendo A = A) instead of Xbox positions
k.m.ps.p: Layout, sensitivity, and button positions are kept on the PC (they apply to all phones and are included in backups). Control size and press vibration stay on this phone.
k.m.ps.rumble: Vibrate when the game vibrates the controller
k.m.reset_confirm: Reset all buttons to their original position and size for this layout?
